items.title: Provide Minneapolis sick and safe time
items.authority: City of Minneapolis Labor Standards Enforcement
items.description: Employers must give employees paid sick and safe time: 1 hour for every 30 hours worked, up to 48 hours a year and 80 hours overall, or front-load 48 hours a year. Keep a written policy and give it to new hires, display the Minneapolis labor standards poster in each language spoken by 5% or more of employees, and show employees the hours used and available each pay period.

note: The City Clerk states there is no general business license; only certain specific business types need a license.
Only specific license types (building trades, peddlers, cannabis, transportation network companies) were found; no general business license was confirmed.
